description: Accumulated 34-, 50- and 64-kt wind swath of Hurricane Melissa (AL132025) over its whole life (5 polygons) built by NHC from the best track wind radii. The area that experienced at least tropical-storm, 50-kt and hurricane-force winds according to the working best track. Derived columns start_time, end_time (UTC). NHC: "The working best track wind swath is created by accumulating the best track wind radii over the course of an ongoing tropical cyclone."

table:columns.name: RADII
table:columns.description: NHC FGDC metadata (.shp.xml in the source zip): 'The wind speed in knots associated with the bounding polygon': 34 (1 polygon), 50 (3 polygons), 64 (1).

table:columns.name: STORMID
table:columns.description: NHC FGDC metadata (.shp.xml in the source zip): 'A unique character string ... BBNNYYYY' -> al132025.

table:columns.name: BASIN
table:columns.description: NHC FGDC metadata (.shp.xml in the source zip): basin code, lower-case 'al'.

table:columns.name: STORMNUM
table:columns.description: NHC FGDC metadata (.shp.xml in the source zip): sequential number of the cyclone in the basin (13).

table:columns.name: ADVNUM
table:columns.description: NHC FGDC metadata (.shp.xml in the source zip): advisory number; '000' on every swath row (not tied to one advisory).

table:columns.name: STARTDTG
table:columns.description: NHC FGDC metadata (.shp.xml in the source zip): 'The time and date at which a tropical cyclone first has winds of at least tropical storm force' (YYYYMMDDHH UTC). Parsed into start_time.

table:columns.name: ENDDTG
table:columns.description: NHC FGDC metadata (.shp.xml in the source zip): 'The time and date of the latest advisory for tropical cyclones that are still active. For tropical cyclones that no longer exist, ENDDTG is the time and date in the best track when the system was last designated as a tropical cyclone' (YYYYMMDDHH UTC). Parsed into end_time.

table:columns.name: start_time
table:columns.description: Derived (CARTO): STARTDTG parsed to UTC; 2025-10-21 06:00 UTC on every row.

table:columns.name: end_time
table:columns.description: Derived (CARTO): ENDDTG parsed to UTC; 2025-11-01 06:00 UTC on every row.

table:columns.name: geometry
table:columns.description: Accumulated wind-swath polygon (all valid) in lon/lat WGS 84 (typed OGC:CRS84 in the hosted file); extent -79.74, 13.04, -42.64, 50.16.

table:columns.name: bbox
table:columns.type: STRUCT(xmin DOUBLE, ymin DOUBLE, xmax DOUBLE, ymax DOUBLE)
table:columns.description: GeoParquet bounding-box covering column (xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax) written for predicate pushdown; not an NHC attribute.
